<span id="interface-guide" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
= <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><nowiki>Interface Guide</nowiki></span> =
<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed pvme-export-media-meta" style="margin:0.8em 0;padding:0.6em 0.8em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;max-width:100%;"><strong>Contents</strong><div class="mw-collapsible-content" style="max-height:24em;overflow:auto;">

<div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="introduction" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Having a proper interface setup is important as it allows you to organize your game view and have quick, convenient access to game windows that you frequently interact with such as inventory, gear, familiars, ability bars and so on. A good interface can make the game easier to play and more enjoyable.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="what-is-the-user-interface" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>What is the User Interface</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Creating a good interface is all about displaying the interface elements in a way where everything you need to access is open and important elements are appropriately close to one another, to minimize the distance your eyes and mouse need to travel around your screen.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="default-interface" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Default Interface</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>The game comes with a pre-made layout, this aims to provide a usable base for every kind of player.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/HZkDZaJlB1.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>While this serves as a good start after adding the additional action bars, it does have a couple issues, such as:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The existing space is not well utilised</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tabs are not appropriately sized</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Wasted space between interface elements</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Missing interface elements</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Summoning/familiar tab</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Worn equipment tab</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Defensives tab</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="useful-interface-elements" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Useful Interface Elements</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>We can observe that some UI elements are more important than others for PvM, including:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Additional action bars</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - gives access to a wider range of keybinds by increasing the number of action bar slots visible on-screen at any given time</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Inventory</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - goes without saying</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Worn equipment</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - useful to ensure correct gear is being worn, unequip armour for certain situations, activate your pocket slot items, etc</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Familiar</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - makes it easier to track special move points, call your familiar if it's misbehaving, and make it attack faster</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Spellbook</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - allows you to quickly switch auto-cast spell</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Minimap</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - a larger minimap (where permissible) can make it easier to get a high-level overview of areas and navigate quickly</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Chatbox</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - most mechanics and interactions will have some form of chat message, and keeping an eye on them can be useful. Also pairs well with the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Alt1 plugin</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Buff/debuff bars</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - keep track of all buffs/debuffs on the player</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Specific style windows</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - it can be helpful sometimes to have additional menus open like the defensives tab, magic spellbook or style-specific ability tabs, to click on certain abilities or spells that you might not want to (or cannot) keybind</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Other non-essential but nice-to-have menus include:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Skills menu</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Friends list</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Friends/Clan/Group chat lists</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Prayers tab</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Drops tab to track drops</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Runemetrics tab to track statistics/damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="creating-a-good-interface" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Creating A Good Interface</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Keeping in mind the important elements of a good interface, we can use the earlier one as a reference and modify it into a layout more suitable for PvM and general gameplay. We'll do this in two broad steps - </nowiki><strong><nowiki>bringing into view and arranging important menus</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, and then using the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>edit layout mode</nowiki></strong><nowiki> to customise the interface further. Any minor tweaks or changes can be made afterwards with ease. Almost every interface element can be found by hovering the ribbon categories.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: This is only an example to demonstrate how to create an interface, but it is ultimately up to personal preference.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="step-1-interface-layout" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Step 1: Interface Layout</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>The first step is to set up the main menus and layout of the interface.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Unlock the interface</nowiki></strong><nowiki> by clicking the lock icon on the Options ribbon, or using the default keybind </nowiki><strong><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>L</nowiki></code></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The bottom centre to the lower right is chosen as the focus for the main PvM menus</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Extra action bars are added</nowiki></strong><nowiki> to give us more keybinds to use</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This option can be accessed through </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Escape &gt; Edit Layout Mode &gt; Action Bars</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The minimap is adjusted, and the Options ribbon is made smaller</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The ribbon can be edited by clicking the small pencil-in-box edit icon in it</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Useful PvM tabs are added around the area of focus - such as the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>inventory</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>familiar interface</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, </nowiki><strong><nowiki>worn items</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, </nowiki><strong><nowiki>defensives</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, and </nowiki><strong><nowiki>spells</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Additional menus such as the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>skills menu</nowiki></strong><nowiki> or </nowiki><strong><nowiki>friends list</nowiki></strong><nowiki> are placed in relatively accessible locations</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Tabs are made large enough to </nowiki><strong><nowiki>eliminate extra scrollbars wherever possible</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Some of the non-essential but useful menus are added and fill in any glaring gaps</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Without much effort, we now have an interface that looks something like this:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/FrZsV7CK9v.png</span><nowiki>
The basic structure of the interface has taken shape, but there are still customisations that can be made.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: A portion of the game window is now covered by interface menus - this will be adjusted in the next step.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="step-2-edit-layout-mode" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Step 2: Edit Layout Mode</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>After finalizing the basic layout, the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>edit layout mode</nowiki></strong><nowiki> can be used to customise how some detailed and important aspects of the interface, such as the buff/debuff bars, split private chat, the game view etc.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ To access the menu, press </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Escape &gt; Edit Layout Mode</nowiki></strong><nowiki> and you'll be greeted with a menu that looks similar to the following image. Click the tickboxes to add or remove overlays from the view to customise</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/k0HRt49m43.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Click the tickboxes to add or remove overlays from the view to customise.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The </nowiki><strong><nowiki>buff/debuff</nowiki></strong><nowiki> bars are placed close to the focus of the interface, near where the character stands in the centre of the screen, to make them easier to see</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The </nowiki><strong><nowiki>channel bar</nowiki></strong><nowiki> is placed close to the focus of the interface, and made sure not to cover the buff/debuff bars</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The </nowiki><strong><nowiki>private chat</nowiki></strong><nowiki> is split and placed to one side to prevent it from cluttering up the chatbox</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The </nowiki><strong><nowiki>extra action button</nowiki></strong><nowiki> is kept in an easy-to-click location</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The </nowiki><strong><nowiki>boss instance/kill timers</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, and </nowiki><strong><nowiki>slayer counter</nowiki></strong><nowiki> are visible and don't cover other menus</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Group invitation</nowiki></strong><nowiki> popups are placed off to one side to prevent them from being misclicked, say during a boss fight</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The </nowiki><strong><nowiki>game view</nowiki></strong><nowiki> can be customised in the same way. The following screenshots compare two game view sizes, indicated by the red outline</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/QOrNAqUyhw.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/WuJJI2A86q.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Adjust the game view to avoid having large portions of it covered by the interface and to your preference.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ This can affect the visibility of some bosses</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ It affects where the player character is centred in your field of view</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="saving-interface-layout" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Saving Interface Layout</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>To </nowiki><strong><nowiki>save</nowiki></strong><nowiki> a layout, open the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Edit Layout Mode</nowiki></strong><nowiki> menu and click on a preset name in the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Save Layout</nowiki></strong><nowiki> dropdown menu, and confirm the changes. Here you can also give it one of the naming options to more easily remember your interface.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:276px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/Uou11B31Yd.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>To </nowiki><strong><nowiki>load</nowiki></strong><nowiki> a layout, click on one of the created/saved load-outs accessed by pressing </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Escape</nowiki></strong><nowiki> and selecting a preset from the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Load Layout</nowiki></strong><nowiki> dropdown menu.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:304px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/N0jNtGN6yJ.png</span><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="miscellaneous-settings" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Miscellaneous settings</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Some options that can improve the UI are listed under the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Gameplay &gt; Interfaces &gt; Appearance</nowiki></strong><nowiki> settings. Consider enabling the following options if they are not already:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Slim headers</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Hide title bars when locked</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Transparency (adjust to your preference)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Chat style: modern</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Minimap shape: square</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ For very high-resolution displays, or simply for better visual clarity for tasks such as recording videos, the interface scaling can be adjusted under the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Graphics &gt; Interface Scaling</nowiki></strong><nowiki> setting</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>Note: Changing the interface scaling may prevent Alt1 plugins from working, due to how they read the text in the chatbox</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The size of the Bank interface can be adjusted - simply unlock the interface, and it can be moved/resized</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/NDTcpCE9c7.png</span><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="interface-searching" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Interface searching</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>If you do not want to go through the effort of customising your own interface, you can press </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Escape</nowiki></strong><nowiki> and go into </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Edit Layout Mode</nowiki></strong><nowiki> to then search for a player, this lets you copy their interface, hovering over the presets shows you the resolution they use.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ This function only works for players that have enabled sharing in </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Settings &gt; Gameplay &gt; Interfaces &gt; Interface Sharing</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:245px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/KCOF2ENQFZ.png</span><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="example-interfaces" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Example Interfaces</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>At the end of the day, a good interface is the one that works for you. Look for common patterns in the interfaces of good PvMers to see how they structure them and why it helps them PvM.</nowiki></p>

</div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="settings-menu" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Settings Menu</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>The </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Settings</nowiki></strong><nowiki> menu is accessed through the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Options</nowiki></strong><nowiki> menu in-game, reachable at any time by pressing </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Escape</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, and contains in-game settings that can be modified. Here, we cover several useful/important options that can be customised.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/iWprrL4oGa.png</span><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="gameplay-settings-interfaces" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Gameplay Settings &gt; Interfaces</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>These settings affect your screen area, visible interfaces and information, and general QoL.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Game Interaction &gt; Mouseover tooltips</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep this on to make it easier to ensure your clicks land on their intended target</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Game Interaction &gt; Mouseover tooltip options</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Shows the amount of extra options on hover, disable for less screen clutter</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Game Interaction &gt; Walk markers</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Makes it easier to see where the character is moving when ground tiles are not visually clear, or when animation stalls occur (stalling abilities, delayed animations)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Game Interaction &gt; Disable shortcuts to close windows</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Prevent UI windows from being accidentally closed if keybound</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Game Interaction &gt; Slim headers / Hide title bars when locked</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Reduces the space taken up by bulky title bars</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Game Interaction &gt; Extra potion info</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Show all effects of any potion being consumed</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Information Windows &gt; Slayer counter</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep open to see slayer task counts without needing a slayer helm or slayer gem. Can click the icon to toggle and show reaper tasks</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Information Windows &gt; Highlight boosted skills</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Show when skills are boosted above or drained below their usual values, useful to know when to re-apply boosts like overloads or notice stat drains from mechanics or items like saradomin brews</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Information Windows &gt; Boss kill/instance timers</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Shows the time since the start of the fight/instance, which can be used to keep track of mechanics</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Warning Screens</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can disable warnings to enter certain areas quicker, such as the Wilderness. Can also add security features like item value warnings and requiring bank PINs on every login</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Inventory &gt; Drag-to-drop</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Disable this to prevent accidentally dropping valuable items</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Inventory &gt; Auto-teleport/destroy empty containers</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• QoL for skilling</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Buff Bar</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Turn on everything to ensure you have all necessary buffs, and know if you are ever debuffed</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="gameplay-settings-combat-action-bar" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Gameplay Settings &gt; Combat &amp; Action Bar</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>These settings affect your combat and gameplay experience concerning PvM.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Combat Mode &gt; Familiar combat mode</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Set to </nowiki><em><nowiki>attack same target</nowiki></em><nowiki> to maximize the damage done by the familiar</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Action Bar &gt; Ability cooldown timer</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Choose between having the cooldown timer centered, or top right</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Combat Mode &gt; Ability queueing</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ability queueing lets abilities be </nowiki><em><nowiki>queued</nowiki></em><nowiki> in advance, to activate once ready. This has both benefits and downsides</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Action Bar &gt; Additional action bars</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Have up to 4 </nowiki><em><nowiki>extra</nowiki></em><nowiki> on-screen action bars for more keybinds</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• More details in </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Keybinds and Action Bars</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> section</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Action Bar Binding</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bind action bars to weapon categories to automatically switch bars when swapping weapons</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• More details in </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Keybinds and Action Bars</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> section</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Choose Option Menu &gt; Player/NPC attack options</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Choose what click options are available for players and NPCs to avoid misclicks</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Choose Option Menu &gt; Hide familiar options</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Prevent accidentally misclicking familiars during combat with things like bladed dive or intercept</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Targeting &gt; Target reticules</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Indicate what targets are selected (</nowiki><em><nowiki>yellow</nowiki></em><nowiki> circle) or aggroed to the player (</nowiki><em><nowiki>red</nowiki></em><nowiki> circle)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Targeting &gt; Target scenery with targeted movement abilities</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Toggles the ability to Bladed Dive/Dive directly onto scenery. Turning this off will prevent you from diving onto scenery accidentally</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Targeting &gt; Target cycle settings</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Set up Target Cycle to target monsters with keybinds</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Target cycling can target monsters at precise times, switch between multiple targets rapidly in multi-target scenarios, and in some cases target monsters earlier than they normally would be attackable (e.g. any of the GWD2 bosses like Vindicta or Helwyr)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Hitsplats</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Customise hitsplat colours to distinguish between different hits in combat more effectively</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="gameplay-settings-camera" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Gameplay Settings &gt; Camera</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Settings to do with camera and camera movement.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>System &gt; Camera mode</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Different camera modes offer different levels of maximum zoom and rotation speed, it is recommended to use freedom mode for better visibility</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>System &gt; Camera shake</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Toggle whether the camera shakes during cutscenes and certain PvM encounters</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Situationally useful - e.g. enable for ED2 (to see dragon special attacks easier), but disable for RotS (easier to escape tunnels without the shaking effect)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="gameplay-settings-item-drops" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Gameplay Settings &gt; Item Drops</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>These settings impact the loot system and the visual appearance of drops.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Loot System &gt; Use area loot</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Area loot opens up a menu to loot items, both opening the interface and looting items can be keybound</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Can be customised based on item quantities, types and values to determine what gets looted</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Useful to avoid accidentally missing loot on the floor</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Loot Beams &gt; Show loot beams</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Highlights items above a player-defined threshold with a customisable beam to avoid accidentally not picking them up</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="gameplay-settings-chat-social" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Gameplay Settings &gt; Chat &amp; Social</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>These settings affect the chatbox and MMO aspects of the game.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Chat Customisation</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Customise how your chatbox appears, decide what messages are shown and in what colours, and re-size text, amongst other options</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Enabling </nowiki><em><nowiki>Split private chat</nowiki></em><nowiki> will make it easier to keep track of private messages</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Accept Aid</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These settings affect what 'aid' spells other players can cast on you. It is recommended to use the following specific settings to ensure you can receive buffs from other players during group PvM:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Invitations</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - </nowiki><em><nowiki>everybody</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Tele-other</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - </nowiki><em><nowiki>nobody</nowiki></em><nowiki> (keep this </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>OFF</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> to avoid potential lures)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Lunar spells</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - </nowiki><em><nowiki>everybody</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Seren spells</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - </nowiki><em><nowiki>everybody</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Other assists</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - </nowiki><em><nowiki>everybody</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="controls" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Controls</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>These settings are used to set all keybinds used within the game, affecting everything from action bar bindings to UI elements to hidden hotkeys. It is recommended to go through the controls set to ensure they are to your preference, but some of the less well-known keybinds that can be set are mentioned for convenience.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Quick prayer</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - this keybind toggles on/off all prayers set to quick prayer simultaneously</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Target cycle</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - keybinds for target cycling</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Special attack</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - can keybind weapon special attacks without having to sacrifice an ability bar slot*</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Familiar action</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - can keybind familiar actions without having to sacrifice an ability bar slot*</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Extra action button</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - can trigger extra action button effects (in fights like Solak or Zamorak) without clicking it</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Area loot</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - open the area loot menu without moving</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: Special attack and familiar action keybinds cannot be queued with ability queueing if set through the Controls tab. Use the action bar if queueing is required.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="graphics" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Graphics</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>These settings affect the visual appearance of the game. Depending on your computer's specs, you can adjust these to improve the game's performance or increase the graphical fidelity of the game. Some useful ones are covered here, but more detailed explanations of all the options can be found on the RuneScape Wiki page about Graphics Settings.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Draw distance</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - the higher this setting, the more of the world is visible, but it can impact FPS on slower machines</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Remove roofs</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - this can make it easier to navigate the world (e.g. for activities like solving clues)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Textures</nowiki></strong><nowiki> and </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Terrain Blending</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - these make the game significantly nicer to look at, but when both are disabled, certain areas of the game may become easier to navigate</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• e.g. placing dummies at Solak might become easier due to ground tiles at Solak becoming visible</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Interface Scaling</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - changes interface scaling anywhere from 70-300%</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Mouse-over entity highlights</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - when the cursor hovers over and clicks an object, a coloured outline appears, with the colour depending on what was interacted with (non-monster NPC, monster NPC or interactable terrain)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="accessibility" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Accessibility</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>These settings increase entity clarity.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Entity Highlight Mode</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - options for how the game chooses what to highlight</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Entity Highlight Type</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - choose between border or silhouette highlighting</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/0Tc2b2mJPN.png</span><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="action-bars" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Action Bars</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Action bars are part of every player's interface containing slots that you can drag different actions to keybind. This section covers basic information about action bars, extra action bars, and action bar binding.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="action-bar-basics" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Action Bar Basics</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Action bars have 14 slots that can be filled with a variety of actions, including but not limited to abilities, prayers, spells, and gear switches. To populate the bar, simply drag an action onto a slot on the bar.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: If this does not work, then your bar is </nowiki></em><em><nowiki>locked.</nowiki></em><em><nowiki> To unlock your action bar, click the golden lock icon on the primary bar (shown in the following picture).</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:609px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/2AATN75VNi.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>In addition to the ability slots, the primary action bar also displays:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Health</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - the red meter</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Adrenaline</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - the yellow meter</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Prayer points</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - the purple meter</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Summoning points</nowiki></strong><nowiki> OR </nowiki><strong><nowiki>special move points</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - the green meter, click this to toggle it</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Additionally, the four icons on the bar can be interacted with to enable some settings:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Clicking the heart icon will turn on </nowiki><strong><nowiki>regenerate</nowiki></strong><nowiki> which will enable once outside combat</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Clicking the sword icon will toggle </nowiki><strong><nowiki>auto-retaliate</nowiki></strong><nowiki> mode on and off - when this is on, the icon will be replaced with a pair of cross swords</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Right-clicking the prayer and summoning icons will let you set up quick prayers and configure a familiar action respectively</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These can then be activated by clicking on their respective icons, or keybinding them</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The golden lock icon can be toggled to </nowiki><strong><nowiki>lock the action bars</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, this prevents changes being made to abilities on any bar</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Right-clicking the cog will bring up access to combat settings and quickly change combat mode</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="action-bar-presets" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Action Bar Presets</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>The number on any action bar indicates what </nowiki><strong><nowiki>preset</nowiki></strong><nowiki> for that bar is currently loaded. There are a total of 18 presets (10 in free-to-play). Adding an action to the action bar is sufficient to update the preset. The preset can then be loaded to any action bar by changing the number on that bar.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: clicking the number icon</nowiki></em><nowiki> of the action bar will bring up a list of presets that can be loaded.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:628px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/prulhUMfss.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Action bar presets can be named in the settings found at </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Settings &gt; Gameplay &gt; Action Bar &gt; Change Action Bar Preset Names</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="additional-action-bars" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Additional Action Bars</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Additional action bars can be displayed by enabling them through </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Settings &gt; Gameplay &gt; Action Bar &gt; Display Additional Action Bars</nowiki></strong><nowiki>. You can have up to </nowiki><strong><nowiki>four additional bars</nowiki></strong><nowiki> for a total of five on-screen at any given time.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:543px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/DEayN1PfPr.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Additional bars provide more slots to place actions for keybinding, reducing the number of things you need to manually click. They also facilitate easier switching of gear during combat and can overall improve your gameplay experience as you take time and familiarize yourself with your keybinds while playing.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="action-bar-binding" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Action Bar Binding</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Action bars can be configured to switch automatically depending on the weapons equipped by the player, this settings can be found in </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Settings &gt; Gameplay &gt; Action Bar Binding</nowiki></strong><nowiki>. Both the primary and additional action bars can be bound, independent of one another if needed. Bindings can be made for when the following types of weapons are equipped:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ only 2h weapons</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ only dual wield weapons</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ either 2h or dual wield weapons</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Consider the following example:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>⬥ Action bar preset number 1 → ability bar for 2h magic</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>⬥ Action bar preset number 2 → ability bar for dual wield magic</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>⬥ Action bar preset number 13 → additional ability bar for magic-related abilities and switches</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>We want our primary action bar to change based on our equipped weapons, and our secondary bar to change based on our equipped style.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/7Nrz4BVCCq.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>In the above example, the first two binding setups change the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>primary action bar</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ When equipping dual-wield magic weapons, it switches to preset number 1 (named Magic - Dual Wield)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ When equipping two-handed magic weapons, it switches to preset number 2 (named Magic - Two-handed)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>The third binding setup changes the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>additional action bar</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ When equipping any magic weapons, it switches to preset number 13 (named Magic - Switches)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>When set up correctly for multiple styles, it will look something like this:</nowiki></p>
<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;margin:0.9em 0;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:4px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:5px;">[https://img.pvme.io/images/CAcj8vQaZO.mp4 <nowiki>Watch clip</nowiki>]</span>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="keybinds" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Keybinds</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>When it comes to setting up keybinds, some important points can help structure your keybinds and make them easier to incorporate into PvM. The goal is to make learning your keybinds less frustrating, and feel more natural to use. This is done by making a few decisions.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="keybind-tips" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Keybind Tips</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Keybinds should be </nowiki><strong><nowiki>easy to reach</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - moving your hands too far can make it difficult to find and press keys</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Consider placing your more </nowiki><strong><nowiki>frequently used binds closer</nowiki></strong><nowiki> at hand, and rarely-used ones further away</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Bind </nowiki><strong><nowiki>similar items</nowiki></strong><nowiki> near each other</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Overhead prayers</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Food and brews</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Weapon switches</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Modifier keys</nowiki></strong><nowiki> can increase the number of binds available, at a cost - it is easier to press one key than two</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This affects things such as prayer switches which occur very often. For more information, look at </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Modifier Keys</nowiki></strong></ins></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>Certain </nowiki><strong><nowiki>common rapid input sequences</nowiki></strong><nowiki> that are often used as your PvM progresses are worth considering when choosing binds. It is helpful to have easy-to-press keybinds sequences for such scenarios. An input such as </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>q → w → r</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎is easier to press than something like </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>q → ctrl+w → alt+r</nowiki></code><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Examples of such input sequences:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Spellbook swap </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sbslunars">[[File:Spellbook Swap (Lunar) icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489467682816.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sbslunars</nowiki>|<nowiki>sbslunars</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + Disruption shield </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="disrupt">[[File:Disruption Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>|<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Mainhand </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="lengmh">[[File:Dark Shard of Leng.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308146098227.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>lengmh</nowiki>|<nowiki>lengmh</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + Offhand </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="lengoh">[[File:Dark Sliver of Leng.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/883134308070604870.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>lengoh</nowiki>|<nowiki>lengoh</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Solid food </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="sailfish">[[File:Sailfish.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489363087360.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>sailfish</nowiki>|<nowiki>sailfish</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + Blubber </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="blueblubber">[[File:Blue blubber jellyfish.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689530593742291033.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>blueblubber</nowiki>|<nowiki>blueblubber</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + Saradomin brew </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="brew">[[File:Saradomin brew (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489400573962.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>brew</nowiki>|<nowiki>brew</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Roar switch </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="roarofawakening">[[File:Roar of Awakening.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>roarofawakening</nowiki>|<nowiki>roarofawakening</nowiki>]]</span> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="odetodeceit">[[File:Ode to Deceit.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417683058917517.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>odetodeceit</nowiki>|<nowiki>odetodeceit</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + Ingen </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ingen">[[File:Ingenuity of the Humans.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ingen</nowiki>|<nowiki>ingen</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + Soulfire spec </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="spec">[[File:Weapon Special Attack.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>spec</nowiki>|<nowiki>spec</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + Omniguard </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="omniguard">[[File:Omni guard.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>omniguard</nowiki>|<nowiki>omniguard</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Using an MMO mouse</nowiki></strong><nowiki> gives many easily accessible buttons to bind actions to</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Using the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>middle mouse button for camera</nowiki></strong><nowiki> instead of keys frees up 4 keybinds</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It can also be easier to move the camera during PvM using the mouse</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="modifier-keys" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Modifier Keys.</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: If you release the modifier before the key first, it will trigger the underlying key press. Keep this in mind when setting up modifier keys.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Shift</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Alt</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, and </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Ctrl</nowiki></strong><nowiki> keys can be used to modify keybinds</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>A</nowiki></code><nowiki>, </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Shift+A</nowiki></code><nowiki>, </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Ctrl+A</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Alt+A</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎would be four separate keybinds</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ This increases the range of available keybinds</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If using a mouse, you can bind </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Modifier+Key</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎to a single mouse button, making it easier to press</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Some gaming mice software may not work on all operating systems, especially Linux</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Logitech mouse users have an open-source option for Linux called </nowiki><em><nowiki>logiops</nowiki></em><nowiki>. Find it in your favourite distro's repository (e.g. Chaotic-Aur for Arch Linux users) or look at their repository at </nowiki>[https://github.com/PixlOne/logiops <nowiki>https://github.com/PixlOne/logiops</nowiki>]<nowiki>. Note that other options such as </nowiki><em><nowiki>xbindkeys</nowiki></em><nowiki> or </nowiki><em><nowiki>input-remapper</nowiki></em><nowiki> will not work to hold down a mouse key and have it act like holding down </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Shift</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎or </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Control</nowiki></code><nowiki>, they can only do a one-time click, not extended holds, despite what their documentation says. Lastly, there are also other alternatives such as </nowiki><em><nowiki>Piper</nowiki></em><nowiki> for consideration</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• On Mac, the </nowiki><em><nowiki>Logitech Gaming Software</nowiki></em><nowiki> may be a useful alternative to the default G-Hub software</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><strong><nowiki>Disclaimer</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Any unofficial third-party tools are as always recommended to be installed and used at your own risk.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="utilising-additional-action-bars" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>

<span id="keybinds-guide" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Keybinds Guide</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>As a reference, check out this very well-thought-out guide to setting up the keybinds that can help you plan your keybinds.</nowiki></p>

<span id="banking-presets" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Banking &amp; Presets</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Bank organization is very much a subjective choice, and entirely up to your preference. There are some items that you may want to consider when sorting and placing in your tabs.</nowiki></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="bank-tabs" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Bank Tabs</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Having well-sorted bank tabs can make it easier to keep track of gear upgrades, and ensure you have enough supplies to last your bossing trips, which is especially relevant for group PvM, so you do not have to interrupt gameplay and slow your teammates by having to buy supplies during an hour.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>PvM gear</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - armour, weapons, switches, jewellery, pouches, quivers, and other related items</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Supplies for PvM</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - all kinds of food, potions, runes, ammunition, summoning pouches + scrolls, and more</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Herblore tab</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - optional but might make it easier to keep track of your supplies to make potions with (more relevant for ironmen)</nowiki></p>
