</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="bank-presets" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Bank Presets</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Bank presets make it easy to equip entire loadouts with a single click. There are 18 presets available, accessible by clicking the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>cog icon</nowiki></strong><nowiki> at the bottom right of your bank interface. We can cover a few important points about presets here.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/4WLm6Y71Up.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/WvBCI8Rzrf.png</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Every preset can be configured to load </nowiki><strong><nowiki>any combination</nowiki></strong><nowiki> of the inventory, worn items and beast of burden storage (if summoned)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This can be done by clicking the yellow icons next to the preset (or the tick boxes below the preset list)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ To save a preset with the currently equipped items, select a preset slot and click the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Overwrite</nowiki></strong><nowiki> button at the bottom left</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ To save the beast of burden storage, use the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>dedicated Beast of Burden</nowiki></strong><nowiki> located below preset number 18</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The middle section of the interface shows the inventory/worn items that will be equipped when that preset is loaded</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can quickly drag and drop items into this section to instantly update the preset</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Exact Matching</nowiki></strong><nowiki> option will check for perks when equipment is withdrawn if there is an augmented item in the preset</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• After enabling this option, you must re-save the preset with the correct augmented items for it to apply</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is useful when you have multiple of the same item but with different perks</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Presets can be dragged and dropped to re-order them</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Saved presets can be loaded within the bank interface by clicking the numbered icons at the bottom right corresponding to each preset</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They can also be loaded using the number keys </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>1</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>2</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎for the first two presets, and </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Alt+(number)</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎for higher presets</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Here is an example demonstrating setting up and loading a preset:</nowiki></p>
<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;margin:0.9em 0;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:4px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:5px;">[https://img.pvme.io/images/pDdD6tAO9B.mp4 <nowiki>Watch clip</nowiki>]</span>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>

<span id="quick-banking-preset" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Quick Banking Preset</nowiki></span> ===
